mapper.select: select rating as rating, guest_visible as guestVisible, note as note from media_rating_policy order by rating asc
mapper.insert: insert ignore into media_rating_policy (rating, guest_visible, note) values (#{rating}, #{guestVisible}, #{note})
mapper.update: update media_video set content_rating = #{rating} where id = #{id}
update media_album set content_rating = #{rating} where id = #{albumId}
